# Joachim Demuth

Tech Lead based in Copenhagen, Denmark. Building products and teams at P-Secure — automated background checks for companies in critical infrastructure.

## Background

Started in UX and digital design at Telenor and smaller studios, then moved into engineering and technical leadership. Works at the intersection of design and engineering — equally comfortable defining a product and building it.

## Education

- MSc in Digital Design & Interactive Technologies, IT University of Copenhagen
- BSc in Digital Design & Interactive Technologies, Aarhus University

## Skills

Design: UX design, product design, interaction design, Figma
Engineering: TypeScript, React, Next.js, Tailwind CSS, Node.js, AI/agentic workflows
Leadership: product direction, engineering team management, technical decision-making

## Work

- Tech Lead at P-Secure (2025–present): https://p-secure.com
- Design Engineer at P-Secure (2024–2025)
- Product Designer at Maybe Tomorrow (2023–2024)
- Digital Designer at VENZO (2022–2023): https://venzo.com
- Digital Designer at Telenor (2021–2022): https://telenor.dk

## Projects

- Should I Buy This Vinyl? — LLM-based app for vinyl record decisions: https://shouldibuythisvinyl.com
- Slaatto Morsbøl — website for a Copenhagen architecture studio: https://slaattomorsboel.dk

## Interests

Film photography (Olympus OM-1, Olympus Mju I and others), vinyl record collecting, music discovery.

## Open to

Collaborating on projects where design and engineering need to work together. Particularly useful early — taking an idea from concept through to a working product built on modern frameworks like Next.js and React. Comfortable owning both the product thinking and the implementation, or working alongside a team that needs someone who can bridge the two. Reach out at jdemuth18@gmail.com.
